entity.name: PDFTara
entity.description: PDFTara is an India-based open-source software initiative and Udyam Registered MSME (UDYAM-UP-69-0015414). We develop privacy-focused, offline-first productivity and creative software, including PDFTara Studio and PDFTara Pixel. Our mission is to make professional software accessible through open-source development.

projects.name: PDFTara Studio
projects.description: A cross-platform desktop productivity suite for Windows, macOS and Linux. Built with Electron, TypeScript and Python. The project focuses on offline-first document processing, PDF editing and a local AI Copilot powered by Ollama. Funding will support development, testing, performance optimization and cross-platform releases.

projects.name: PDFTara Pixel
projects.description: An open-source professional photo editing application built with Rust. The project aims to provide advanced raster graphics editing, layers, masks, adjustment tools, vector workflows, PSD compatibility and GPU-accelerated rendering. Development priorities include performance, image format compatibility and local AI-assisted image editing.

channels.description: Direct INR bank transfer to PDFTara, India. Bank details will be provided securely after funding approval. Contact: admin@pdftara.com.

plans.name: PDFTara Studio - Development and Local AI
plans.description: Funding requested for six months of engineering, offline document processing improvements, local Ollama AI Copilot development, Windows/macOS/Linux packaging, testing, documentation and community support.

plans.name: PDFTara Pixel - Rust Photo Editor Development
plans.description: Funding requested for six to nine months of Rust engineering, advanced layer and mask systems, GPU rendering optimization, PSD compatibility, image processing, testing and development of local AI-assisted editing capabilities.
